spanish: y la cubierta de pieles de los carneros las enrojecidas, y la cubierta de pieles de los tahash, y la parójet del masaj,

findings.issue: The Pual passive participle is masculine plural and agrees with the rams; feminine plural «las enrojecidas» assigns the reddening to «pieles».
Common noun left untranslated as «tahash» instead of Spanish.
Common noun left untranslated as «parójet» instead of Spanish.
Common noun left untranslated as «masaj» instead of Spanish.

notes: Object markers add no lexical item; «y» and both coverings of skins match the conjunctions and construct nouns.
